enchantments.tooltip: Stunning +4: +4 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.
Minor Action Boost Enhancement: This will increase the total number of Action Boosts you can use by 1. However, these additional Action Boosts will only take effect after the wielder rests.
Insightful Armor-Piercing 2%: Passive: +2% Insight bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
Insightful Constitution +1: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +1 Insight bonus to Constitution.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
